reason: Integrates DeepSeek Harness file, subprocess, Bash, terminal, and LSP operations with short-lived Tensorlake microVMs; human review is warranted due to remote command execution, external credentials, full-access policy options, and documented dependency advisories.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的文件、子进程、Bash、终端和 LSP 操作转移到短生命周期的 Tensorlake 微虚拟机中执行。
summaries.en: Moves DeepSeek Harness file, subprocess, Bash, terminal, and LSP operations into short-lived Tensorlake microVMs.

capabilities: Runs Bash and subprocess operations inside an ephemeral Tensorlake microVM
Provides remote filesystem, terminal, subprocess, and LSP services to DeepSeek Harness
Creates and terminates external Tensorlake sandboxes during dsh profile lifecycle
Uses Tensorlake and DeepSeek API credentials supplied through the host environment
Can operate with a danger-full-access Bash sandbox policy
